Format a date/time value for NIMS API query parameters

Source: R/parse_time_arg.R
format_datetime.Rd

Accepts a POSIXct, POSIXlt, Date, or character string and returns a character string in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Character strings are passed through unchanged; the API accepts both ISO 8601 and NIMS-standard date strings.

Usage

format_datetime(dt, arg_name = deparse(substitute(dt)))

Arguments

dt

A POSIXct, POSIXlt, Date, or character string, or NULL.

arg_name

Name of the calling argument (for error messages).

Value

A character string, or NULL if dt is NULL.
